'''Molos''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that was ruled by [[King/Legends|King]] [[Amand/Legends|Amand]] and controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] sent aid to the planet after the civilians [[Uprising on Molos/Legends|rose up]] against the Empire. They formed an [[Molos army/Legends|army]] and [[Battle of Molopolis|fought]] off the Imperial reinforcements in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Molopolis/Legends|Molopolis]].<ref name="Lead" />
